south.subject_description: a young male janitor with brown hair and a red bandana, cream shirt and blue work overalls, holding a grey aluminium baseball bat
south.initial_pose: mid-stride walking pose, legs apart, facing the camera, gripping the bat with both hands, the bat raised up over his shoulder on the left side of the image
south.action_description: He keeps walking forward in place at a steady pace and never stops: his legs keep striding alternately like a looping walk cycle. While his legs keep walking, only his upper body attacks: he swings the bat hard and fast in one wide horizontal arc at chest height, sweeping across in front of him from one side to the other. The grey aluminium bat leaves a bright white crescent-shaped swoosh of air behind it along the whole arc of the swing. He follows through, the tail of the red bandana flicking. The swoosh fades away quickly and he brings the bat back up into the starting guard grip, still walking, ending in the same mid-stride walking pose he started in. Static camera, completely locked-off shot. Maintain the crisp 2D pixel art aesthetic, thick dark outlines, flat colors, same character size and strict original low top-down perspective throughout.
